items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, you know Hammond has written about going and hearing Freddie Green, that he was playing there with Teddy Clark and a bass player by the name of Frank Clark. [INTERVIEWEE] His brother, half-brother, yeah.

ctx.x: Oh, no, this was a specialty then, this was like a show. This was the show thing. Well, we had a show, we had people performing you know, a regular routine but when these guests came --
Well, you know Hammond has written about going and hearing Freddie Green, that he was playing there with Teddy Clark and a bass player by the name of Frank Clark.
